import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Convert 'is_takeaway' column to categorical
coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] = coffee_sales['is_takeaway'].astype('category')

# Plot a bar chart of top 5 products by total sales
top_products = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))

plt.title('Top 5 Products by Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.title('Top 3 Payment Methods by Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Payment Method')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
